notes: The reversed co-brand lockup is not a separate file. The page reverses cobrand-logotypes.png with filter: brightness(0) invert(1), so both marks including the AWS smile turn white together.

Reversed logo states are not separate files either. Each family ships a colour master and a mono master; both reversed states are the colour master under the same filter, which is what stops a reversed mark drifting from the one it reverses.
